alerts.headline: Marine Weather Statement issued November 18 at 3:55PM PST by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
alerts.desc: FRONTAL PASSAGE WILL BRING THUNDERSTORMS TO THE COASTAL WATERS NOW THROUGH AT LEAST THURSDAY MORNING A moist and unstable air mass will bring the potential for thunderstorms to the coastal waters. Any thunderstorm that forms will be capable of producing locally gale force winds and rough seas, dangerous lightning, heavy rainfall with reduced visibility, and waterspouts..
